name: Old Varn
title: Sparkwright
examine: Woke from the Ring mid-sentence, he says, and has spent forty years trying to finish it. Both sleeves are scorched. He is delighted.
lines: The spark goes where you look, not where you wave. Took me nine years to... anyway. Where you look.
I was saying something important when I came through the stones. It will come back to me.
Scorch marks are just the circle keeping notes.
